message.text:
The default driver is SQLite. Viper sets it via `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the flag defaults to `"sqlite"` in `cmd/memos/main.go`. The factory method `NewDBDriver` routes to `sqlite.NewDB` based on `profile.Driver`.

`Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`. The concrete INSERT is executed by `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` at line 16. The SQL statement is at line 41. The determination method follows the default flag and viper setup through the factory switch to the SQLite implementation.

h12.
sqlite.DB.CreateMemo — store/db/sqlite/memo.go; default driver is sqlite via cmd/memos/main.go, selected by NewDBDriver

With no DB flags, `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the `--driver` default in `cmd/memos/main.go:122` / `:130` set `profile.Driver` to `"sqlite"`. `db.NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:18-20`) then constructs `sqlite.NewDB`. `store.Store.CreateMemo` only forwards to `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109-113`). The INSERT that actually runs is `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16-51`, `INSERT INTO \`memo\`` at line 41). MySQL and Postgres have the same method, but the factory never picks them on a default install.
